ai.literal: Sorrow to us to remain, far away he who went thinking of, fragrant flowers felt ashamed eyes.
ai.translation: Thinking of him who went far away leaving me in sorrow, my eyes have wept so much that they feel ashamed before fragrant flowers.
ai.modern: நமக்குத் துன்பம் மட்டும் எஞ்சி நிற்க, தொலைதூரத்திற்குச் சென்ற காதலரை நினைத்து அழுது என் கண்கள் அழகிழந்து நறுமணமுள்ள மலர்களைக் கண்டு வெட்கப்படுகின்றன.
ai.explanation: The speaker laments the loss of her physical beauty due to the sorrow of separation. Her lover has gone far away, leaving her with nothing but distress. Constantly thinking of him and weeping, her once-beautiful eyes have lost their luster. Now, they feel ashamed to even look at fresh, fragrant flowers, knowing they can no longer match their beauty.

ai.literal: He who loved / not granting / things that say / it seems / having paled / tears / flowing / eyes
ai.translation: My eyes, turning pale and brimming with tears, seem to proclaim the unkindness of my lover.
ai.modern: பசலை நிறம் கொண்டு கண்ணீர் வடிக்கின்ற என் கண்கள், என் காதலர் எனக்கு அன்பு காட்டாததை உலகத்தார்க்குச் சொல்வன போல இருக்கின்றன.
ai.explanation: The speaker observes the physical toll that separation has taken on her eyes. They have lost their natural beauty, turning pale (பசந்து), and are constantly shedding tears (பனி வாரும்). She feels that these visible signs of sorrow act as a public declaration. They seem to announce to everyone the unkindness (நல்காமை) of her lover (நயந்தவர்), who has left her to suffer without his comforting presence.

ai.translation: My shoulders, which swelled with joy on the day we united, now seem to clearly announce his departure.
ai.modern: நாம் கூடியிருந்த நாளில் மகிழ்ச்சியால் பூரித்திருந்த என் தோள்கள், இப்போது மெலிந்து அவர் என்னை விட்டுப் பிரிந்து சென்றதை ஊராருக்குத் தெளிவாக அறிவிக்கின்றன.
ai.explanation: The heroine laments the physical toll of her lover's absence. She contrasts her current state with the day they united, when her shoulders swelled with joy. Now, those same shoulders have grown so thin that they seem to loudly announce his departure to everyone. The word 'வீங்கிய' (swelled) highlights the past joy, making the present wasting away of her shoulders an undeniable proof of her loneliness.

ai.literal: Plumpness having left, fresh bracelets will slip, companion having separated, natural beauty faded shoulders.
ai.translation: Separated from my companion, my shoulders have faded and lost their natural beauty; as their plumpness vanishes, my fresh bracelets slip off.
ai.modern: துணைவர் என்னை விட்டு நீங்கியதால், என் தோள்கள் தம் பழைய அழகை இழந்து வாடிவிட்டன. அவற்றின் பருமை குறைந்துவிட்டதால் அணிந்துள்ள அழகிய வளையல்கள் கழன்று விழுகின்றன.
ai.explanation: This couplet describes the physical toll of separation on the heroine. Because her lover has left her, her shoulders have withered, losing their original, natural beauty. As they lose their fullness and grow thin, the beautiful bracelets she wears become too loose and slip off. The word paṇai can mean bamboo or plumpness; here it refers to the plumpness of healthy shoulders, which vanishes in her grief.

ai.literal: Reward will you get, O heart, to the cruel one my fading shoulders' distress having told?
ai.translation: O heart, will you gain any reward by telling that cruel man about the distress of my wasting shoulders?
ai.modern: நெஞ்சே! அந்தக் கொடியவரிடம் சென்று, மெலிந்து வாடும் எனது தோள்களின் துன்பத்தைச் சொல்வதால் நீ ஏதேனும் பயனைப் பெறுவாயா?
ai.explanation: The heroine addresses her own heart, questioning the usefulness of sending a message to her absent lover. She calls him cruel because he has stayed away, causing her intense suffering. The word 'pūcal' usually means an uproar or battle, but here it vividly describes the intense distress of her wasting shoulders. She asks if there is any 'pāṭu' (which can mean greatness, but here means reward or benefit) in telling him of her physical decline, doubting that it will prompt his return.

The word 'பேதை' (naive girl) highlights her innocent and overly sensitive nature in love, unable to bear even the slightest physical distance.
